The Spirit of
Hornsby Railway Hotel
The Hornsby Railway Hotel was built in 1888 by Martin Haydon who in those early colonial days catered for the Hornsby community and travellers alike with a “home away from home” character that reflected the traditional food and beverage of the time.
Not much has changed except today Hornsby has grown into a cosmopolitan city of its own. The hotel focuses on creating a warm, friendly atmosphere where you will enjoy the relaxed feeling time and time again. Our sports bar is equipped with a modern TAB, big TVs, a courtyard and, most importantly, our welcoming regulars.

Dine at
The Bistro
We understand that dining is a key facet to a successful hotel and our aim is to provide you with an enjoyable, casual dining experience that will leave you wanting to return time and time again. With an extensive menu including contemporary pub favourites, we are sure there will be something to suit any taste or occasion.
The bistro can cater for everyone from families, groups, or an intimate dinner for two! A very comfortable and modern atmosphere awaits you.

Celebrate with us
Functions
When it comes to planning functions, corporate events, product launches, or end of year celebrations, we’re all looking for a venue capable of ensuring it’s a runaway success.
The Hornsby Railway Hotel specialises in tailor-made functions and has the expertise to ensure that your next function is a truly memorable – think of your birthday, engagement, reunion & more! We are able to offer exclusive access to our nightclub and DJs on both Friday and Saturday night from 7-11pm.
Please fill out the function form to help assist us with your enquiry. Our events team will be in touch shortly.
Explore Our
Large Event Space
PRIVATE FUNCTIONS & EVENTS
We love hosting parties and functions. Our large event space is a great space for birthdays & celebrations, hens nights, corporate events, or to simply just hang out with a group of friends.
Private bookings can be discussed with our team by calling 9477 1115 .
Accommodation
Stay with us
The Hornsby Railway Hotel offers a number of newly renovated, well presented rooms just half an hour outside Sydney city centre and only a few easy steps from Hornsby train station. The hotel is surrounded by many cafes, restaurants and retail outlets.
Rooms start at $275 per week. Rent is paid weekly and in advance.
If you are interested in staying at the hotel, please call the hotel on 9477 1115 to book or arrange an inspection. We look forward to welcoming you to the hotel
Our rooms
• Contain brand new built-in wardrobes, new beds, new flat-screen TVs, bar fridges and bedside tables.
• Share modern bathrooms with showers and toilets.
• Have use of clothes washing and drying amenities.
• Guests can cook their own meals in the communal kitchen and relax in the communal living area.
• Are non-smoking.
